title: E Duo Unum
program_note:
E Duo Unum, or Out of Two, One, was written as a wedding present for violists Paul and Gina Coletti.  It begins with two melody lines for the two violas in hocketing counterpoint—a dovetailing of notes and rests between two different instruments or voices.  Out of these two hocketed lines emerges a single melody.  Soon commenting on this melody is the other viola, in counterpoint, out of which emerges a new single line.  By the end of the piece, in the marriage of the two contrapuntal lines, the melody coalesces into a single voice, in happy unison.

This is an arrangement of the viola duo for two cellos.
